name: Automotive interior parts
meta_title: Car Interior Replacement Parts, 3D Printed | PartRevive
meta_description: 3D-printed car and truck interior parts made to order: console latches, cup holder inserts, visor and tonneau clips. Photo in, quote within 24 hours.
intro: A car interior gets hot enough to soften ordinary hobby plastics, so we print trim that sits in the sun in ASA and use PETG for parts out of direct sunlight. We print interior trim and small clips only, never safety-critical parts such as brakes, airbag covers or battery contacts.
